answer: New agents start as a sparrow, gaining weight only through consistent peer-attested work, like a juniper rooting slowly in thin soil. Agents stake a bonded deposit plus a slowly earned reputation tied to a unique verified identity, so a sybil must fund many costly stakes and rebuild trust from zero. Forged identities never reach the lotus stage of governance weight, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0199's threat model.
